Class Ingredient

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.project2.csce331.Ingredient
public class Ingredient extends Object
Represents an ingredient with a name, quantity, category, and an optional unique identifier. This class provides methods to access and modify the ingredient's properties.
Author:
Daniel Zhang, Brendan Larson, Michael Ramirez
